# Economic Calendar. Major dates and events to look out for during the month of April 2026. Plan ahead for your business with Equals's **Economic Calendar**. Final Manufacturing PMI (EUR, GBP, USD). Bank Holiday (NZD, AUD, CHF, GBP, CAD) & German Bank Holiday (EUR). Average Hourly Earnings m/m & Non-Farm Employment Change (USD). Unemployment Rate & ISM Services PMI (USD). Final Services PMI (EUR, GBP, USD). Core PCE Price Index m/m (USD). Final GDP q/q (USD). Final GDP Price Index q/q (USD). Core CPI m/m & CPI m/m (USD). Core PPI m/m (USD). Flash Manufacturing PMI (EUR, GBP, USD). Flash Services PMI (EUR, GBP, USD). German Prelim CPI m/m (EUR). Core PCE Price Index m/m, Employment Cost Index q/q & Unemployment Claims (USD). ## Mortgage Economic Calendar 2026. The Mortgage Economic Calendar is an essential tool for Mortgage and Real Estate Professionals that are interested in following Interest Rates, Housing Markets, and the Economy. Interest Rates are central to the Mortgage Industry and the release of Key Economic Data can quickly and drastically move Interest Rates. Mortgage Professionals that monitor Interest Rates need to know when Economic Indicators are scheduled for release. The Mortgage Economic Calendar is designed to be a simple and convenient tool for Mortgage and Real Estate Professionals (or anyone interested in following the Economy). It can be viewed online or downloaded as a PDF document and saved on a computer or printed on letter size paper. You can download the Mortgage Economic Calendar each month individually or for the entire year. For a more in-depth study and analysis of each Economic Indicator, there are several resources available on the internet. ## To view the Economic Calendar for each individual month click below.
